subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should wedged channel runtimes request a full gateway restart through the generic ChannelAccountSnapshot.processRestartRequired contract, or should this recovery use a narrower Telegram-owned injected seam?
rationale: Both designs preserve the required hard process boundary, but the generic field becomes a public cross-channel lifecycle capability whose ownership and future use cannot be inferred safely from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Keep the generic contract
options.body: Approve the optional snapshot field as the standard bounded signal for channel runtimes whose in-process wedges cannot be recovered by channel stop/start.

options.title: Use a Telegram-owned seam
options.body: Replace the snapshot field with a narrow injected restart request owned by Telegram while preserving the same detection, budgeting, and supervised restart behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic contract
recommendation.body: Approve the optional snapshot field as the standard bounded signal for channel runtimes whose in-process wedges cannot be recovered by channel stop/start.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context identifies this person with the Telegram spool and polling lifecycle area where the signal originates.
